local_out_of_sync_with_cloud.summary: Local library version differs from cloud (either direction).
local_out_of_sync_with_cloud.body: Run `cartograph cloud sync`. Sync is bidirectional: for each widget, whichever side has the higher version wins. Use `--dry-run` first to preview. This is the right answer whether local is ahead, behind, or you don't know.

checkin_blocked_no_changes.summary: Checkin failed because widget content is identical to the last version.
checkin_blocked_no_changes.body: The no-op checkin guard refuses to bump a version when nothing actually changed. Either make a real code change or, if you only need to update metadata (tags, description), edit widget.json and stage that change before checkin. Do not work around the guard by adding whitespace.

validation_contamination_detected.summary: Validation failed with contamination errors (project-specific imports, paths, or symbols).
validation_contamination_detected.body: Strip everything project-specific from the widget. Common contamination: imports from the consuming app, hardcoded paths, environment-specific config, references to sibling modules outside the widget. The widget must be self-contained in cg/<widget_id>/. Move the project-specific glue back into the consumer app; only the reusable core belongs in the widget.

publish_blueprint_rejected_public.summary: Cloud publish of a blueprint to the public registry returned 403.
publish_blueprint_rejected_public.body: The public registry refuses blueprints by policy. Blueprints are personal templates or org-internal compositions, not shared library entries. Options: (1) keep the blueprint local, (2) publish to a private/org registry with `--publish` after `cartograph registry add`, (3) extract the reusable parts into individual widgets and publish those instead.

widget_missing_from_search.summary: A widget exists in the library but doesn't appear in search results.
widget_missing_from_search.body: The library integrity scan hides widgets without a valid validation stamp. Run `cartograph status <widget_dir>` to confirm. To restore: re-run `cartograph checkin <path> --reason 'restamp'` which re-validates and writes a fresh stamp. Do not edit the stamp file by hand.

engine_missing_for_language.summary: Validation or scaffolding fails because the language engine is not installed.
engine_missing_for_language.body: Run `cartograph doctor` to see which engines are present and what each one needs. Install the missing toolchain on the host (e.g. iverilog 12+ for systemverilog, openscad 2021.01+ for modeling, node for javascript/typescript). If the binary is in a non-standard location, set `cartograph config paths.<engine> <path>` so Cartograph can find it.
